mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.body, m.kind, m.created_at FROM im_group_summary s JOIN im_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = s.group_id AND gm.user_id = #{userId} JOIN im_group_message m ON m.group_id = s.group_id AND m.id BETWEEN s.first_message_id AND s.last_message_id AND m.id > gm.joined_after_id AND m.recalled_at IS NULL WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.first_message_id > gm.joined_after_id ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT 30
